To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
student feedback is a valuable source of information to improve the learning environment, but its quality and usefulness are dependent upon the process by which feedback is obtained and used.

(a) The current student feedback system is not ideal for collecting feedback for continuous quality improvement; (b) A new feedback system was designed and implemented to obtain better feedback for quality improvement; (c) The new feedback system was implemented successfully; (d) The implementation of the new feedback system was a continuous quality improvement process; (e) The new feedback mechanism is more effective than the previous system in obtaining feedback for quality improvement.
student feedback can be used as an instrument to enhance the quality in teaching and learning, but only if the process of collecting feedback is improved to ensure that it is reliable.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the quality improvement of the feedback process and its use in the evaluation of the clinical teaching environment.
how to obtain impactful student feedback to improve the quality of teaching in a medical school.
how to improve a student feedback system to obtain better inputs to enhance the quality and effectiveness of the feedback system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the feedback mechanism at YLLSoMs is a useful tool in improving the quality of teaching and the learning environment for students, and it is a valuable tool to measure and improve the quality of teaching.
the feedback system is a continuous process of quality improvement and that there is always a need to review the process to obtain better inputs to enhance the learning environment.

the student feedback process is a continuous process that is not static, it is dynamic, it is a living organism, it is a process that is constantly evolving, and it needs to evolve to meet the needs of the medical students, the faculty, the clinical teaching site and the institution.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully implemented a new system to obtain impactful feedback from students and have also demonstrated the importance of continuous quality improvement.
it is important for medical schools to constantly review and improve their feedback system to obtain better inputs from students for improving the learning environments.
the student feedback mechanism is not a one-time exercise but rather a process that requires continuous improvement to ensure that it meets its objectives.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the student feedback process can be improved to obtain more meaningful data to improve the quality of teaching and learning.
a well-designed and well-executed feedback system can provide a powerful and useful tool for improving medical education and training.
the student feedback system can be improved by involving more stakeholders in the feedback process.
